preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains an integer T representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 100 for N in [int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, len(lines)) if i % 2 == 0])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(x in [0, 1, 2] for x in markers) for markers in [list(map(int, lines[i].split())) for i in range(1, len(lines)) if i % 2 == 1])
preconditions.description: The markers for each test case are N integers, each being 0, 1, or 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in [(int(u), int(v)) for line in lines[2:] for u, v in [line.split()]])
preconditions.description: Edge endpoints u and v are valid vertex indices between 1 and N.
The input graph for each test case is guaranteed to be a tree with N vertices and N-1 edges.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each line of output is a valid integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout_lines[i]) <= 2 for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: The minimum unattractiveness for each test case is an integer between 0 and 2 inclusive.

For each test case, the output integer represents the minimum possible value of the maximum absolute difference between markers assigned to adjacent vertices, over all valid assignments of the given markers to the tree vertices.
